The '''Atrium''' was a central location in the [[Czerka Corporate Labs]]<ref name="Flashpoint" /> on the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]].<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=codex|CZ-198}}</ref> In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref> the Atrium was attacked by a strike team tasked to [[Seizure of CZ-198|infiltrate]] the facility and confront the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] Special Executive [[Rasmus Blys]].<ref name="Flashpoint" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Atrium appears in the "Czerka Corporate Labs" flashpoint as part of the Game Update 2.3 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]].<ref name="Titans of Industry">{{TORweb|url=gameupdates/titans_of_industry|text=TITANS OF INDUSTRY}}</ref>
